title: Beloved Lord of the Gopiis
lead: A song addressed to the Supreme Beloved with a plea for grace and communion. It reveals the image of the inner Vrindavan: the divine dance unfolds not in distant sacred lands, but in the innermost depths of each human heart.

lines.structure: Address: Gopijanavallabha (Beloved Lord of the gopiis).
lines.natural: O beloved Lord of the gopiis,
lines.image_note: A classical Vaishnava address to Krishna, reinterpreted as an address to the Supreme Beloved of all devotee souls.

words.meaning_here: eyelids (lit. tender shoots/petals of the eyes)

lines.structure: Predicate: melo; direct object: ánkhi pallava.
lines.literal: Open wide of the eyes shoots [eyelids],
lines.natural: Pray, open Your eyelids,
lines.image_note: Poetic comparison of eyelids and eyelashes to tender spring foliage and flower petals (pallava).

words.meaning_here: waiting for You, for Your sake

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier: tomár tare; compound verbal predicate: base áchi.
lines.literal: You for the sake of seated I am [waiting],
lines.natural: I sit and await You.
lines.image_note: Base áchi conveys the patient, concentrated expectation of a loving heart.

lines.structure: Address: Gopijanavallabha.
lines.natural: O beloved Lord of the gopiis,
lines.image_note: Repetition of the refrain/leitmotif line of the song.

words.form: nominative case, nominal part of predicate

lines.structure: Subject: tumi; nominal predicate: ságarer maṇi (copula omitted).
lines.natural: You are the jewel of the ocean,
lines.image_note: An image of a treasure hidden in the boundless depths of existence.

words.meaning_here: in the innermost depth of the soul
raised a wave of sound, awakened a vibration

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier: marme; predicate: tulecho; object: dhvani.
lines.literal: In the core You raised sound,
lines.natural: You have stirred a resonance deep in my heart,
lines.image_note: Marma - the innermost spiritual core of a human being.

lines.structure: Modifier: tava karuṇár; object: kaṇá; predicate: jáci.
lines.natural: I pray for a drop of Your grace,
lines.image_note: The motif of absolute humility in a devotee: even the smallest particle of grace can transform life.

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier: tomár tare; predicate: base áchi.
lines.literal: You for the sake of seated I am [waiting],
lines.natural: And I sit waiting for You.
lines.image_note: Choral refrain.

lines.structure: Subject: Tomár liilár sthāna (the full sentence continues into the next line).
lines.natural: Is the place of Your divine play
lines.image_note: The question expands the traditional concept of holy places to the entire universe and the human heart.

lines.structure: Interrogative adverbial of place: shudhu ki Vrindávane.
lines.literal: Only is it really in Vrindavan?
lines.natural: Only in Vrindavan?
lines.image_note: A rhetorical question denying the geographical limitation of God.

words.meaning_here: in the heart of every human being

lines.structure: Subject: tumi; predicate: nece calecho; adverbial modifier: mánuśer mane mane.
lines.literal: Dancing You go on of man in mind-mind,
lines.natural: You keep dancing in the depths of every human heart,
lines.image_note: The reduplication 'mane mane' conveys omnipresence: in every mind without exception.

words.form: locative case of the adjective prakáshya
locative case functioning as an adverb

lines.structure: Coordinate adverbials of manner: kakhano prakáshye, kabhu saḿgopane.
lines.natural: Now openly, now in deep secret,
lines.image_note: God reveals Himself either by visible inspiration or by an unheard inner stirring of the heart.

words.form: present tense, 1st person plural (agreeing with sabái as collective 'we')
words.meaning_here: we look for, yearn to find

lines.structure: Subject: sabái; object: tomáre; predicate: khuñji.
lines.natural: We all search for You,
lines.image_note: The search for the Supreme is recognized as the fundamental urge of every consciousness.

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier: tomár tare; predicate: base áchi.
lines.literal: You for the sake of seated I am [waiting],
lines.natural: And I sit waiting for You.
lines.image_note: Refrain.

words.meaning_here: in the Vrindavan of the mind
in the Gokul of the soul

lines.structure: Adverbials of place: man Vrndávane, man Gokule; predicate: rayecho.
lines.literal: Mind's in Vrindavan You dwell, mind's in Gokul,
lines.natural: You dwell in the Vrindavan and Gokul of our mind,
lines.image_note: Vrindavan and Gokul are not past geographical spots, but levels of spiritualized human consciousness.

words.meaning_here: in time, to the rhythm of the dance

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier of manner modifying dole (in the next line): Tomár núpur tále.
lines.literal: Your ankle bells in the rhythm
lines.natural: To the rhythm of the bells upon Your feet,
lines.image_note: The rhythm of the Lord's cosmic dance stirs and sets the whole universe in motion.

lines.structure: Subject: atal niiradhi; predicate: dole.
lines.natural: The bottomless ocean sways.
lines.image_note: Niiradhi - the ocean of infinite consciousness, responding to the steps of the Lord.

words.meaning_here: the flute (symbol of the divine call)

lines.structure: Coordinate object: tomár adhar veńu (to the verb pete cáy).
lines.natural: The flute upon Your lips,
lines.image_note: Krishna's flute embodies the call of the Infinite resounding for every soul.

words.meaning_here: the tiniest blessed particles of dust from the feet

lines.structure: Coordinate object: caraṇ dhulir reṇu (to pete cáy).
lines.natural: And the pollen-dust of Your feet,
lines.image_note: Caraṇa-reṇu - a mark of supreme devotion and the sanctification of the spirit.

words.form: infinitive of purpose in -te from páoyá

lines.structure: Infinitive phrase: pete cáy (subject is implied: the heart/soul).
lines.natural: The soul longs to receive,
lines.image_note: An unquenchable thirst for closeness to the Divine.

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier of place to the predicate: káchákáchi.
lines.natural: Drawn closer and closer.
lines.image_note: Káchákáchi conveys the most intimate closeness, dissolving all distance between the soul and God.

lines.structure: Adverbial modifier: tomár tare; predicate: base áchi.
lines.literal: You for the sake of seated I am [waiting],
lines.natural: I sit and wait for You.
lines.image_note: The final chord of waiting.

heard: In the subtitles and singing in lines 10 and 14: in line 10 the subtitles write 'manujer', sung as 'manujer' / 'mánuśer'; in line 14 it is written 'Mana Vrinda'vane', sung as 'mano bṛndábane'
In line 6 it is sung as 'tava karuṇár kaṇá jáci' (with a distinct clear long vowel at the end), while the subtitles give 'kan'a' ja'ci'
In lines 19-20 the subtitles merge them as 'Pete ca'i ka'cha' ka'chi', which is also sung as a single unbroken musical phrase
interpretation: The song is a mystical interpretation of Vaishnava motifs. Here, the Lord of the gopiis (Gopiijanavallabha) is not merely a cowherd from historical legend, but Parama Puruśa - the Supreme Consciousness, whose abode (Vrindavan and Gokula) lies not in geographical space, but inside the mind of every creature. He dances incessantly in the hearts of all human beings (mánuśer mane mane), revealing Himself openly or remaining concealed. The ocean of cosmic creation sways to the rhythm of His footsteps, and the supreme goal and longing of the individual soul (jiiva) is to feel the closest intimacy with Him, to merge into the melodies of His beckoning flute, and to attain the blessing of humility at His lotus feet.
